name: KitchenOwl
description: KitchenOwl is a self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager. Track what you need to buy, add recipes, plan meals, and sync your household shopping lists across all your devices in real time.
longDescription: KitchenOwl is a self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager. Track what you need to buy, add recipes, plan meals, and sync your household shopping lists across all your devices in real time.
